note: Doubter catches missing error responses and idempotency contract for a money-moving endpoint.

spec_excerpt.description: checkout a cart and create an order

recorded_output:
## Doubter Findings

FINDING: error responses undefined
  Spec lists only 201. What about: 404 (cart not found), 409 (already checked out), 422 (empty cart), 502 (payment provider failed). Without these, implementer will guess and clients will see undocumented behavior.

FINDING: idempotency contract missing
  Checkout creates an Order and charges money. A duplicate POST from a network retry will double-charge unless the spec mandates Idempotency-Key. Real money bug class.

FINDING: side effects of checkout undocumented
  Does checkout decrement inventory, emit a CartCheckedOut event, queue a confirmation email? Each is a crosscutting concern that the spec should pin down.

Recommendation: extend spec with {error_responses: [404, 409, 422, 502], idempotency: required (Idempotency-Key), side_effects: [decrement_inventory, emit_event, queue_email]}.
